naslov: Utah takes on Orlando, looks to break 9-game slide
tekst:
Orlando Magic (3-7, 11th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-10, 15th in the Western Conference)
              Salt Lake City; Wednesday, 9 p.m. EST
              LINE: Magic -4.5; over/under is 217.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Utah aims to end its nine-game skid when the Jazz take on Orlando.
              Utah went 22-60 overall a season ago while going 14-27 at home. The Jazz shot 46.7% from the field and 34.5% from 3-point range last season.
              Orlando went 45-37 overall, 26-26 in Eastern Conference action and 19-21 on the road a season ago. The Magic averaged 115.7 points per game while shooting 46.4% from the field and 34.3% from behind the arc last season.
              INJURIES: Jazz: Lauri Markkanen: out (wrist), Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Keyonte George: out (ankle), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee).
              Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: out (knee), Desmond Bane: day to day (illness), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Tristan da Silva: out (calf), Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jalen Suggs: out (knee).
